capabilities: Validate JSON by triggering a parse error
Copy conversion results to the clipboard
extras: Hotkeys are user-configurable; both commands appear to ship with the same default binding (Cmd+Alt+[). Parsing requires selecting a valid JSON string, including the surrounding quotes.
motivation: The author is a developer who writes Markdown in Obsidian but needs to send the Markdown as a JSON string, and to convert it back later for editing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly convert a note selection to or from a JSON-encoded string.
summary: Text converter that runs JSON.stringify() or JSON.parse() on the selected text and copies the result to the clipboard.
